build_module_evaluate: build a python evaluation module that computes accuracy scores from predictions and references
create_module_info: create an evaluation module info object with features, citation, description, and homepage metadata
test_compute_accuracy: test the _compute method that calculates accuracy by comparing predictions against references
review_download_prepare: review the _download_and_prepare method for downloading external resources needed to compute scores
summarize_module_class: summarize the evaluation module class that extends evaluate.EvaluationModule with _info, _compute, and _download_and_prepare methods
